entry_points_exempt.run_tests.py: this IS the runner - an entry point invoking it would recurse. STRUCTURAL AND PERMANENT: no flag could change it.
entry_points_exempt.house_common.py: a shared library. Its __main__ IS its selftest, so there is no second entry point to exercise. STRUCTURAL AND PERMANENT.
entry_points_exempt.verify_confidential.py: its real entry point needs VERIFY_FORBIDDEN_LIST pointing at a file that lives OUTSIDE this repository and may never enter it - the scanner ships, the list never does. Run bare it exits 2, CANNOT CERTIFY, which is correct behaviour and not a start failure, but it makes this arm assert nothing. It is run deliberately, with the environment variable set, at the sessions that need a confidentiality verdict.
entry_points_exempt.verify_deliverable.py: there is no packaged artefact in the tree to point it at. tools/package.py and tools/publish.py DO NOT EXIST - checked by listing - and building them is phase 4's work, not phase 2's. It exits 2 when it cannot run, and a VOID run asserts nothing about starting. TRIGGER THAT ENDS THIS EXEMPTION: the first .skill archive built by a committed script.
entry_points_exempt.trace_instructions.py: it runs as an InstructionsLoaded HOOK and reads its own log back, so its real entry point is a session start rather than a command. Invoking it here would either report on a log this run did not produce or write one, and its log is gitignored because it carries absolute paths.
entry_points_exempt.verify_charter.py: a library, not a command: verify_md.py imports it and runs its charter checks for every document. So verify_md.py's entry point above exercises it at RUN time - check_charter() is called unguarded, so a crash there is a traceback this arm fails - while a failure at IMPORT is caught by verify_md, reported as charter rows that FAIL and exit 1, which this arm counts as a finding: that half is covered by verify_charter's own --selftest suite, which cannot start on a file that will not import. Run bare it prints that it has no run of its own and exits 2, by design - measured 2026-10-16 in a disposable clone, 0 files touched. STRUCTURAL: it is verify_md.py's charter checks, split out on 2026-10-12, and the house exempts it for the same reason.

_comments_expected.runs: TWO RUNS, NOT FOUR, AND THE GAP IS THE POINT. This project had FOUR standing reds until 2026-10-16, when verify_md's 'file length' cleared with the charter under its cap, so the charter run now declares nothing and guards against a new red; THREE remain - verify_code's three rows, stepb_audit's check 10 and claudemd_disposal's carried-nowhere - beside run_tests' 'entry points cover the checkers' row since #146 (DECISIONS-LOG.md, 2026-10-16). ONLY ONE OF THEM CAN BE DECLARED HERE, because verify_expected reads ROWS and not prose, so a command must carry --report-json, and stepb_audit.py and claudemd_disposal.py are this project's OWN tools and have no such flag. Recorded as a declared limit rather than left as an unexplained absence: a reader comparing 'four standing reds' against two runs here would otherwise conclude something had been forgotten. TRIGGER THAT CLOSES IT: --report-json added to either project tool, at which point its red belongs here too. WHAT THIS BUYS THAT PROSE DID NOT: the second arm, 'every declaration still fails'. A toleration that stops being needed is reported as DECL-STALE, so an exemption cannot quietly outlive the defect it was written for - which is exactly what happened to the 350-line cap, retired and still sitting in this file for days.

declared_absent.verify_refs.py: ITS NEEDLE DOES NOT FIT THIS CORPUS, AND THAT WAS MEASURED THREE WAYS RATHER THAN ASSUMED. It treats any quoted string of three or more words as a citation that must resolve to a heading. This project is 308 sub-lexicon and reference files whose CONTENT IS QUOTED TERMINOLOGY - run over the full 365-document universe, 14 of its 22 failure lines are lexicon terms and prose fragments ('long lease / ground lease / emphyteusis', 'imputato', a table row), false by construction. AND THE GENUINELY UNRESOLVABLE ONES ARE UNRESOLVABLE BY DESIGN: REGISTER-findings.md quotes headings from the blind desk review's 2,222-line report, which section 5.6 keeps PERMANENTLY OUTSIDE the repository, so a checker whose universe is the repository can never resolve them and no wider file list will help. Narrowing the universe does not rescue it either: run over the 27 root-and-step documents it reports 9 failures, of which two resolve correctly into references/ that the narrower universe excluded - so both scopes are wrong in opposite directions. TRIGGER THAT ENDS THIS DECLARATION: the day a committed document cites another committed document by quoting its heading title as a CONVENTION rather than incidentally, at which point there is a population to resolve and this row starts being wrong.
declared_absent.verify_crossdoc.py: RUN, AND IT REPORTED 'VOID: nothing was declared for this project' AT 0 EXAMINED on all three arms - and here that is STRUCTURAL rather than an omission. This charter's own section 5.8 rule 4 forbids restating what another document owns and requires every document to have undivided ownership of its facts, so a mirrored claim is designed out rather than merely absent. The one genuine two-document claim class is UK/US VARIANT PARITY, and it is already covered whole-tree by tools/parity_check.py, which compares all 198 files per tree line by line - strictly stronger than one declared string, and of two controls doing one job the house removes the weaker.
